Enumerate all valid instrumental variable sets

Source: R/identification.R
all_iv_sets.Rd

Finds all minimal (or all) sets of valid instruments for identifying the causal effect of x on y; see is_valid_iv().

Usage

all_iv_sets(cg, x, y, minimal = TRUE, max_size = 3)

Arguments

cg

A DAG or ADMG created with cgraph().

x

Exposure node name.

y

Outcome node name, or character vector of node names.

minimal

If TRUE (default), return only minimal sets.

max_size

Maximum number of instruments to consider.

Value

List of character vectors (empty list if none exist).

Examples

if (julia_ready()) {
  dag <- cgraph(
    Z1 %-->% X, Z2 %-->% X, X %-->% Y, U %-->% X, U %-->% Y
  )
  all_iv_sets(dag, "X", "Y")
}
#> [[1]]
#> [1] "Z1"
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] "Z2"
#>
